description: This Java interface defines a contract for providing AuthorizationSubject objects extracted from a JSON Web Token (JWT). It declares a method to retrieve authorization subjects from a given token, which is essential for JWT-based authentication and authorization mechanisms.
external_methods: org.eclipse.ditto.model.jwt.JsonWebToken (constructor or static methods, if any)

classes.name: JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method to extract authorization subjects from a JSON Web Token.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of AuthorizationSubject instances contained within the provided JsonWebToken.
